note: Build knowledge for the Builds tab. Every mod name here was checked against api.warframestat.us/mods (1803 mods) and every arcane against the warframe.market catalog, so nothing in this file is a remembered guess. Edit freely — the app reloads it on restart. Augment names that could not be verified against the mod dataset were removed rather than guessed.
sources: wiki.warframe.com Archon Shard page (bonus values, Tauforged multipliers)
itemku.com Warframe build guide 2026 (Steel Path priorities)

shards.note: Tauforged shards give roughly 1.5x the listed value. Five slots per frame; archon shards are the single biggest endgame stat jump outside arcanes.
Violet: +25% Melee Critical Damage (doubles above 500 max energy)
Health pickups grant energy and vice versa
Topaz: Secondary Crit Chance +1% per Heat kill (max 50%)

survivability: Vitality or Primed Vigor for health
Rolling Guard to break control and shed status
Primed Flow for the energy pool
Arcane Grace or Arcane Guardian on the frame
auras: Growing Power for a strength burst
Energy Siphon when you have no other energy economy
universal.steel_path: Armour is the wall in Steel Path. Strip it (Corrosive, Heat, or an ability) or bypass it, then Viral multiplies what you do to health. Galvanized mods and Merciless-class arcanes assume you are killing steadily to hold their stacks.

companions.note: Companions die instantly at high level unless they are built to survive or built to never be shot. The Bond mods are the modern reason to bring one.
utility: Primed Animal Instinct for loot radar
Synth Deconstruct with Equilibrium for energy

picks.Panzer Vulpaphyla: the default survivability pick — it self-revives and its Viral spores prime everything
picks.Smeeta Kavat: Charm buffs, still the farming companion

Ash.stats: Strength and Efficiency, Range for Blade Storm marks
Ash.helminth: Roar over Smoke Screen if you want damage
Ash.note: Seeking Shuriken strips armour cheaply — that is Ash's real endgame contribution.

Atlas.stats: Strength and a little Range; his armour is the survivability
Atlas.note: Landslide scales off Strength and never misses. Petrify holds enemies still and softens armour — Atlas is a melee platform with a rock wall.

Banshee.stats: Range and Duration, Strength for Sonar
Banshee.helminth: anything defensive — she is made of paper
Banshee.note: Sonar multiplies weapon damage on marked spots by a huge factor. Silence is the reason she is subsumed everywhere.

Baruuk.note: Serene Storm damage rises as Restraint falls, and Elude makes him functionally untouchable by gunfire.

Caliban.note: Sentient Wrath is armour strip plus a stagger; Lethal Progeny summons conculysts that actually tank for you.

Chroma.stats: Strength above everything; Duration for Vex Armor
Chroma.helminth: nothing — Vex Armor is the build
Chroma.note: Vex Armor multiplies both damage and armour from damage taken. Chroma is still one of the biggest single-target buffs in the game.

Citrine.stats: Strength and Duration, Range to cover the squad
Citrine.note: Preserving Shell is squad-wide healing that does not need line of sight — a genuinely strong support frame.

Cyte-09.note: A marksman frame: Seek marks targets and Neutralize rewards precise shots. Provisional profile — the community meta is still settling.

Dagath.note: Rakshasa Kavat is a free second life — Dagath is squishier than she looks without it.

Dante.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for overguard uptime
Dante.note: Tragedy is the damage, Dark Verse builds the stacks it consumes, and the overguard keeps the squad standing.

Ember.stats: Strength and Range, Efficiency to manage Immolation
Ember.note: Immolation builds heat as you fight and drains energy hard at the top — vent with Fire Blast before it caps.

Equinox.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for the buff halves
Equinox.note: Maim stores damage then releases it — build range so the stored total covers the room.

Excalibur.stats: Strength and Efficiency, Range for Radial Blind
Excalibur.shards: Crimson Melee Critical Damage, Azure health
Excalibur.note: Chromatic Blade converts Exalted Blade damage to an element and scales status — it is the build.

Follie.note: A very new frame built around illusions and perspective. Provisional profile — treat the stat priorities as a starting point.

Frost.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for the bubble
Frost.note: Icy Avalanche gives the squad overguard, which is far better than the old bubble-camping playstyle.

Gara.stats: Strength and Duration, Range for the glass wall
Gara.note: Splinter Storm damage is stored from Shattered Lash — refresh it before the timer, never let it lapse.

Garuda.note: Dread Mirror stores a slice of enemy health as damage — Garuda scales off staying aggressive.

Gauss.stats: Strength and Duration, Efficiency to hold the battery
Gauss.note: Keep the battery in the red band for the damage bonus; Kinetic Plating is the survivability.

Grendel.stats: Strength and Duration, Efficiency for the drain
Grendel.helminth: keep Nourish — it is the best donation in the game
Grendel.note: Nourish gives Viral damage, energy and healing at once, which is why everyone subsumes it elsewhere.

Gyre.stats: Strength and Range, Duration to hold Cathode Grace
Gyre.shards: Crimson Strength, Violet for the electric synergy
Gyre.note: Rotorswell doubles crit chance while active — the whole frame is built around keeping it up.

Harrow.stats: Duration and Strength, Efficiency to keep casting
Harrow.note: Covenant converts damage taken into crit chance for the squad — time it against incoming fire, not on cooldown.

Hildryn.stats: Strength and Range; shields replace energy entirely
Hildryn.helminth: Pillage is itself the best Helminth donation in the game
Hildryn.note: Abilities cost shields, so Flow and energy mods do nothing. Shield capacity is your ability pool.

Hydroid.note: Plunder strips armour and stacks corrosive onto him as a damage buff — the reworked Hydroid is genuinely strong.

Inaros.stats: Strength and Range; huge health, no shields
Inaros.note: No shields means status lands on you constantly — Negation Swarm or Rolling Guard is not optional at high level.

Ivara.stats: Duration and Efficiency, Range for Prowl
Ivara.helminth: nothing essential — Prowl is the kit
Ivara.note: Prowl is true invisibility with a loot bonus. Efficiency keeps the drain survivable while moving.

Jade.stats: Strength and Duration, Range for the beams
Jade.note: Ophanim Eyes is a persistent beam that debuffs and heals; Glory On High is the flight-and-damage window. Provisional profile.

Khora.stats: Strength and Range, with enough Duration to hold the dome
Khora.shards: Crimson for Ability Strength; Azure if you want more survivability
Khora.helminth: nothing essential — the kit is self-contained
Khora.note: Whipclaw reads the mods on your equipped melee (a stat stick). Strangledome groups the room and Whipclaw hits everything caught in it.

Koumei.note: Koumei runs on dice rolls — Omamori grants status immunity on a chance, so Duration keeps the rolls coming. Provisional profile.

Kullervo.shards: Crimson Melee Critical Damage, Azure health
Kullervo.note: Wrathful Advance is a teleport plus a huge guaranteed crit buff — open every fight with it.

Lavos.stats: Strength and Range; he has no energy, only cooldowns
Lavos.helminth: anything — cooldowns mean no energy problems
Lavos.note: Lavos ignores energy entirely, so Flow and Streamline do nothing. Casting speed is his real stat.

Limbo.stats: Duration and Range, Efficiency to hold the rift
Limbo.note: Cataclysm plus Stasis freezes an entire room. Be careful in squads — rifting allies' targets is how Limbo earns his reputation.

Loki.stats: Duration and Range, Efficiency to spam
Loki.note: Radial Disarm turns gunfire into melee, which is still one of the strongest crowd controls in the game.

Mag.note: Magnetize is a damage amplifier: shoot into the bubble and everything inside takes it.

Mesa.stats: Strength and Duration, Efficiency for Peacemaker uptime
Mesa.helminth: Roar or Eclipse for a damage multiplier
Mesa.note: Shooting Gallery is the survivability, not an afterthought. Peacemaker drains harder the longer you hold it.

Mirage.note: Hall of Mirrors multiplies your weapon output; Eclipse is the buff everyone else subsumes off her.

Nekros.shards: Azure health, Amber energy orb effectiveness
Nekros.helminth: Gloom pairs beautifully with Despoil health drain
Nekros.note: Despoil turns Desecrate into a health cost, which Equilibrium then refunds as energy — that loop is the whole farming build.

Nezha.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for Warding Halo
Nezha.note: Warding Halo scales off Strength and armour — recast it before it breaks, not after.

Nidus.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for Larva
Nidus.helminth: nothing essential — mutation stacks are the kit
Nidus.note: Stacks are everything: Larva groups, Virulence feeds, and Undying means you cannot really die once stacked.

Nokko.note: The newest frame; its kit revolves around spores and regrowth. Provisional profile and no documented Helminth donation yet.

Nova.stats: Strength for a speed nova, or negative Strength for a slow nova
Nova.note: Molecular Prime above 100% Strength speeds enemies up; below it slows them. Decide which nova you are before modding.

Nyx.stats: Range and Duration, Strength for Absorb
Nyx.note: Psychic Bolts strips armour and shields on a wide radius — that, not Chaos, is why Nyx still shows up in Steel Path.

Oberon.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for Renewal
Oberon.note: Hallowed Ground plus Renewal gives the squad status immunity and armour — a genuinely good support.

Octavia.helminth: anything — the kit already trivialises most content
Octavia.note: Mallet damage scales off what enemies shoot into it. Amp and Metronome make the whole squad's numbers bigger.

Oraxia.note: Spider-themed: Widow's Brood summons, Webbed Embrace controls. Silken Stride is the Helminth donation. Provisional profile.

Orion & Sirius.note: The other half of the Update 43 dual Warframe. Provisional profile.

Protea.note: Temporal Anchor rewinds you — treat it as a free undo on a mistake, and Dispensary solves energy for the squad.

Qorvex.note: Containment Wall pins enemies and Crucible Blast detonates the pillars — radiation procs make everything hit itself.

Revenant.stats: Duration and Range, Strength for Danse Macabre
Revenant.helminth: Roar or Eclipse to multiply Danse Macabre
Revenant.note: Mesmer Skin is functional invulnerability — count the charges, not the health bar.

Rhino.note: Roar is a damage multiplier for the whole squad and one of the best Helminth abilities in the game.

Saryn.stats: Strength and Duration, Range for spore spread
Saryn.helminth: swap Molt for something if you prefer, but Molt feeds Regenerative Molt
Saryn.note: Spores scale off enemy count, not raw damage — spread first, then let Miasma prime the corrosive.

Sevagoth.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for Gloom
Sevagoth.helminth: keep Gloom — it is the reason to play him
Sevagoth.note: Gloom slows everything and heals you per kill. The Shadow is the damage; Sevagoth himself is the platform.

Sirius & Orion.note: The dual Warframe from Update 43 — you swap between the pair, and Celestial Clash is the shared finisher. Provisional profile.

Styanax.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for Rally Point
Styanax.helminth: nothing — Tharros Strike is the donation everyone wants
Styanax.note: Tharros Strike strips armour and shields instantly and refunds shields per enemy hit. Final Stand is the damage.

Temple.note: A performance frame with an exalted weapon (Exalted Solo) and squad buffs through Overdrive. Provisional profile.

Titania.stats: Duration and Strength, Efficiency for Razorwing uptime
Titania.helminth: anything utility — Razorwing is the build
Titania.note: Dex Pixia is a secondary-weapon exalted, so it uses secondary mods and arcanes.

Trinity.stats: Duration and Efficiency, Strength for Blessing
Trinity.note: Abating Link strips armour while Link keeps her alive — the classic support build still works.

Uriel.note: Infernal kit with Remedium as sustain and Brimstone as the damage window. Provisional profile.

Valkyr.stats: Strength and Duration, Efficiency for Hysteria
Valkyr.shards: Crimson Melee Critical Damage, Azure armour
Valkyr.note: Hysteria is invulnerability with a lifesteal exalted claw. Warcry is the squad buff and the reason she is subsumed.

Vauban.stats: Strength and Range, Duration for Bastille
Vauban.helminth: anything mobile — he is stationary by nature
Vauban.note: Bastille strips armour while it holds enemies, and Vortex groups them into a single point for area weapons.

Volt.stats: Strength and Duration, Range for the shield
Volt.shards: Crimson Strength, Violet for electric synergy
Volt.note: Shields double crit damage for shots fired through them — that is why Volt is an Eidolon frame.

Voruna.note: Fangs of Raksh strips armour, which is exactly what Steel Path asks for.

Wisp.helminth: Roar or Eclipse over Breach Surge for damage
Wisp.note: Motes are the whole frame: haste, health and shock. Drop them before you fight, not during.

Wukong.stats: Duration and Strength, Efficiency for Cloud Walker
Wukong.note: Defy used to be immortality; it is now a timed damage window. Celestial Twin fights alongside you and is the subsume donation.

Xaku.note: The Lost strips armour and Xata's Whisper adds void damage to your guns — it is a weapons platform as much as a caster.

Yareli.note: Merulina is damage reduction you ride; Aquablades and Sea Snares do the work while you stay mounted.

Zephyr.stats: Range and Duration, Strength for Tornado
Zephyr.note: Turbulence deflects almost all incoming fire — that alone carries Steel Path survivability.

subsumable_note: Every warframe donates exactly one ability. Each pair was cross-checked against that frame's real ability list, which rejected 7 wrong entries from the source table. Not yet covered: Nokko. Necramechs cannot be subsumed.
meta_note: Current game state: Update 43 Jade Shadows: Constellations (17 Jun 2026), hotfix 43.0.8. Nidus received an ability retouch in U43. Sirius & Orion is the new dual Warframe from that update; its Helminth donation is not documented yet.

primary_crit.stats: Crit chance and crit damage, then Viral to multiply what lands
primary_crit.note: Hunter Munitions turns crits into Slash procs, which bypass armour entirely — on a crit rifle that is usually more damage than any elemental you could add. Malignant Force plus Rime Rounds makes Viral while keeping the status chance high enough to feed Galvanized Aptitude.

primary_status.stats: Saturate status, then let Viral and Galvanized Aptitude multiply it
primary_status.note: Four dual-stat mods give Viral plus a second element and push status chance past 100%, where Galvanized Aptitude pays +40% damage per status type on the target.

primary_raw.stats: Nothing to scale, so multiply the base
primary_raw.note: With neither crit nor status standing out, damage and multishot are the whole build — Viral still does the heavy lifting against health.

shotgun_crit.stats: Crit and multishot; every pellet is its own damage and status roll
shotgun_crit.note: Shotgun status is per pellet, so multishot raises damage and proc count together. Chilling Grasp with Toxic Barrage makes Viral.

shotgun_status.stats: Status per pellet, which climbs fast on a shotgun
shotgun_status.note: A shotgun rolls status once per pellet, so it saturates a target faster than any other weapon class.

secondary_crit.stats: Crit chance and crit damage, with Lethal Torrent for both fire rate and multishot
secondary_crit.note: Primed Pistol Gambit and Primed Target Cracker are the real pistol crit pair. Frostbite with Pistol Pestilence makes Viral.

secondary_status.stats: Status first — secondaries are the game's best primers
secondary_status.note: A saturating secondary sets up everything else you carry: prime with status, then let the primary or melee collect.

melee_crit.stats: Combo-scaled crit — the highest damage ceiling in the game
melee_crit.note: Blood Rush turns combo count into crit chance and Weeping Wounds turns it into status chance; Condition Overload then pays per status type. Reach is a damage stat here — it decides how many enemies each swing touches.

melee_status.stats: Status types stacked, then Condition Overload multiplies per type
melee_status.note: Condition Overload counts distinct status types on the target, so spreading several elements beats stacking one hard.

melee_heavy.stats: One enormous swing: crit damage and heavy efficiency
melee_heavy.note: Heavy attacks spend the combo counter as a crit multiplier. Corrupt Charge starts you with combo so the first swing already hits hard.

survivability.stats: Keep it alive, then let the Bond mods do the work
survivability.note: Link mods scale off YOUR frame's health, shields and armour, so a tanky frame makes the companion tanky too. The Bond mods are the modern reason to bring a companion at all — Contagious Bond spreads your status, Reinforced Bond feeds shield gating.

damage_mechanics.note: The numbers Steel Path builds are actually built around. Every figure here is from the official wiki's own formula tables, not from memory.
sources: wiki.warframe.com Damage/Viral, Damage/Corrosive, Damage/Heat (stack counts and percentages)

armor.enemy_formula: Damage reduction = 90% x armor / 2700, so 2700 armor is the 90% ceiling
armor.player_formula: Damage reduction = armor / (armor + 300) — 300 armor is 50%, 600 is 67%, 900 is 75%
armor.why: Armour is the wall in Steel Path because it multiplies effective health rather than adding to it. Removing it is worth more than any damage mod you could fit in the same slot.

status.effect: x2 damage to health at 1 stack, rising 25% per stack to x4.25 at 10
status.why: The single largest damage multiplier available to a weapon, and it applies to health — which is what is left once armour is gone.

status.effect: 26% armour stripped on the first stack, +6% per stack after, 80% at the 10-stack cap
status.why: The direct answer to armour. Corrosive Projection stacks on top multiplicatively — a full squad running it plus 10 stacks leaves roughly 3% of the original armour.

status.effect: strips up to 50% armour, ramping 15% / 30% / 40% / 50% over the first 2 seconds, plus damage over time
status.duration: 6s, refreshed by new procs; armour returns over 6s once it lapses
status.why: Half the strip of Corrosive but it arrives on its own and keeps burning, which is why Viral + Heat is the default pairing rather than Viral + Corrosive.

shield_gating.effect: Breaking your shields grants at least 0.33s of invulnerability, longer with a bigger shield pool
shield_gating.recharge: 4s delay before shields restart after a full break; 1s after partial damage
shield_gating.why: A large shield pool is not about absorbing damage — it is about how long the gate lasts. This is why shield-gating frames stack shields rather than health.

steel_path.effect: Steel Path adds +100 to enemy level on top of the node's own scaling
steel_path.why: Enemies do not gain new mechanics, they gain numbers — which is exactly why armour strip and Viral matter more than raw damage mods.

arcanes.note: A Warframe has two arcane slots, a weapon has one, and companions have none. Arcanes rank to 5, which costs 21 copies of the arcane (56 including every rank below). Max-rank numbers below are from the wiki's own tables.

slots.note: An Arcane Helmet costs a Warframe one of its two slots.

warframe.name: Arcane Energize
warframe.effect: 60% chance on an energy pickup to give +150 energy to you and allies within 15m
warframe.why: Energy is the limit on almost every ability build, and this fixes it for the whole squad. The default second slot unless the frame makes its own energy.

warframe.name: Molt Augmented
warframe.effect: +0.24% Ability Strength per kill, up to +60% at 250 kills
warframe.why: The largest strength bonus available to a frame, and it persists until you die rather than expiring. Slow to build, so it rewards long runs — only direct kills count, not Operator or Necramech ones.

warframe.name: Molt Efficiency
warframe.effect: Ability Duration that builds while your shields are up
warframe.why: Pairs with anything you refresh rather than recast — the duration granted on cast is kept even if you later lose shields and the buff switches off.

warframe.name: Arcane Guardian
warframe.effect: 15% chance when damaged to give +900 armour for 20s
warframe.why: Roughly doubles the effective health of an armoured frame, and it triggers constantly in Steel Path because you are always being hit.

warframe.name: Arcane Grace
warframe.effect: 9% chance on health damage to regenerate 6% health per second for 9s
warframe.why: The health-tank counterpart to Guardian. Wants a real health pool behind it.

warframe.name: Arcane Aegis
warframe.effect: 3% chance when shields are damaged to regenerate 30% shields per second for 12s
warframe.why: For shield-gating frames, where shields are a timer to be refilled rather than a health bar.

warframe.name: Arcane Blessing
warframe.effect: Health added on every Health Orb pickup
warframe.why: Only worth it on frames that make their own orbs — Nekros, Protea, Citrine, Oberon, Trinity, Nezha, Voruna.

warframe.name: Arcane Avenger
warframe.effect: Chance on being damaged to give +45% critical chance for 12s to your weapons
warframe.why: A weapon buff worn on the frame — it pushes a borderline crit weapon over the next crit tier.

weapon.name: Primary Merciless
weapon.effect: up to +360% damage, stacking as you kill and refreshing on kills
weapon.why: The default primary arcane: it assumes you are killing steadily, which is exactly what Steel Path looks like.

weapon.name: Secondary Merciless
weapon.effect: the secondary version of the same kill-stacking damage bonus
weapon.why: Same logic on a secondary, which is often the gun doing the priming.

weapon.name: Primary Deadhead
weapon.effect: damage bonus that builds on headshot kills
weapon.why: Beats Merciless on precision weapons where every shot is a headshot anyway.

weapon.name: Secondary Deadhead
weapon.why: Same trade on a precision pistol.

weapon.name: Primary Blight
weapon.why: For status primers rather than damage dealers.

weapon.name: Melee Exposure
weapon.effect: adds Corrosive damage and armour stripping on melee hits
weapon.why: Melee's own answer to armour, so you are not relying on a gun to strip first.

weapon.name: Melee Influence
weapon.effect: Electricity status spreads to nearby enemies
weapon.why: Turns a single-target melee into room clear — one of the strongest melee arcanes in the game.

weapon.name: Melee Crescendo
weapon.effect: builds combo count on heavy attack kills
weapon.why: The heavy-attack enabler: it refunds the combo the heavy attack just spent.

arcanes.effects_source: api.warframestat.us /items/<name> levelStats, max rank — cross-checked against the wiki for Arcane Energize, Guardian, Aegis and Molt Augmented
arcanes.classification_note: Warframe list is the wiki's Arcane Enhancement table plus Persistence, Ultimatum and Warmth (frame stats in their own effect text) and the three Theorem arcanes (wiki: Theorem Demulcent is a Warframe arcane). Emergence are Operator arcanes (wiki: Emergence Savior). The four Molt arcanes are included by name as well as by prefix: each names a Warframe stat (Ability Strength, Ability Duration, ally healing, Warframe Ability Cast) in its own effect text.
